description: A watercolor palette sits to the right of a painted practice sheet, with a white cup holding two brushes near the back of the table and a small stained sponge cloth nearby. The left hand reaches in from the lower left to pick up and hold the left-hand object sponge cloth, while the right hand brings the right-hand object water brush over it and repeatedly rubs and dabs the brush tip against the cloth to wipe off paint, shifting the cloth slightly as it cleans; then the left hand sets the cloth back down and the right hand lifts the brush away toward the palette.
